name: kotlin-lsp-dev
description: Client for the enhanced Kotlin language server built by kotlin-lsp-dev.

kotlinLspDev.serverPath.markdownDescription: Directory of a standalone server installed by `scripts/install.sh`. Empty means `~/.local/share/kotlin-lsp-enhanced`. The server is expected to be self-contained — this extension neither downloads a distribution nor looks for a JDK.

kotlinLspDev.serverPort.markdownDescription:
Attach to a server already listening on `127.0.0.1:<port>` instead of starting one. `0` (default) starts the server over stdio and ties its lifetime to the editor.

Start one yourself with `bin/enhanced-server --socket 9999`. Attaching keeps its log in your own terminal and keeps the JVM warm across editor reloads, at the cost of having to start it.

kotlinLspDev.log.description: Routing detail the composition server writes to its log (KOTLIN_LSP_DEV_LOG).

kotlinLspDev.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP traffic between VS Code and the server, in the extension's output channel.
